subject: RESUME statement
notes: General format: RESUME [AT] { NEXT STATEMENT | procedure-name-1 }, with RESUME, NEXT and STATEMENT underlined and AT not underlined (figure notes; the rendered figure's underlining is what the transcription records). Grammar: `resumeStatement : RESUME AT? (NEXT STATEMENT | procedureName)` - AT optional, one of the two operands required, NEXT STATEMENT both required. PROBED with the pinned cobol.exe: `RESUME M3` and `RESUME NEXT STATEMENT` (no AT) compile and run under --std 2002/2014/2023; under --std 85 both are refused with COBOL0876 ('the RESUME statement requires COBOL-2002'). The unit theory parses all four spellings (with/without AT x NEXT STATEMENT/procedure-name) at 2023; its expected values are the figure's own optional-word reading. [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the RESUME statement belongs to the exception model introduced by ISO 1989:2002; absent from 1985)]
